protocol.phaseDedup: Actual postSTEP1 qpos/qvel/time bytes are captured and compared to actual PRE before lossless back-reference. A witnessed-equality marker and actual phase SHA256 are retained, including signed zero. Any mismatch preserves uncompressed states in error receipt and stops before STEP2.
protocol.projection: PRE/POST complete joint states, actual native point-relative velocity vectors, native contact geometry/row IDs/forces/row velocities/Jdelta, warnings, actuator and constraint forces. Fixed materials and rigid nonflex descriptors are losslessly dictionary factored after actual checks with zero signs. Native H/mu solver caches are outside physical identity/oracle and checked finite live; full partial native copies retained on any first error.
protocol.ownership: No native init by author/default tests. Pinned pure archive exports only are reused; archived CLI/test/main/admission wrappers never invoked. Contact vector and get copies owned; warning/opt borrowed; caller buffers/model/data own lifetime.
protocol.physical: Every preceding stable hold required. First physical failure latches and current hold is retained without extension; a second fresh rate only follows safe full cleanup. First valid tip is immutable, including bracket, and completes existing hold only. Source/phase/ownership errors remain ERROR/UNRESOLVED, never physical PASS or retry.
protocol.boundary: LOCAL biased two-rate threshold only. Old failures/R5 late causal gap and full PHY06/PHY03/D01/D02/editor/deployment remain unchanged.
